subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be adopted on top of current main, narrowed to a smaller follow-up, or paused in favor of the newer merged onboarding direction?
rationale: The branch adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping setup refresh, configured-gateway routing, security-copy, and typography decisions; automation cannot choose that product direction safely.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator route proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample workspace/preview pieces maintainers still want and leave setup and connection-path behavior to current main and focused PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the guided preview tour is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator route proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent configured-gateway routing fix is the clearest current-main ownership signal for the decision surface.
